text:
Ava (CS): Quick heads-up — we have a subset of enterprise onboarders seeing auth failures when fetching embeddings. Need comm plan and translations for FR/DE/JP.
Diego (Support): Oof. Do we have the list of affected tenants?
Ava (CS): Yes — prod_export_2026-03-20 has 42 tenants flagged; 7 are high-touch (contract value > $100k). Sharing in the doc in a sec.
Maya (CS Ops): Suggest splitting comms: 1) High-touch phone + tailored email, 2) Mid customers targeted email + office hours, 3) Bulk in-app banner + FAQ.
Sam (PM): Agree. Also need a proactive note for renewal-risk customers offering credits and a scheduled engineering update cadence.
Riley (Eng): Root cause preliminary: an auth token rotation job miswrote a config for the embedding service clients, causing 401s when downstream cache miss occurred. Rollback applied at 12:14 UTC, partial recovery seen. Full verification in progress. ETA for stable state: 45–90m.
Ava (CS): Can you confirm whether any data was exposed or requests retried erroneously? Customers will ask.
Riley (Eng): No user data exfiltration. Some in-flight requests returned 401s; no retries were triggered by our SDKs. We'll include the exact timeline in the RCA.
Diego (Support): Drafting email templates now. Can I post a sample here for review?
Ava (CS): Please — include short TL;DR, impact, mitigation steps, and next update window. Keep it <5 sentences for subject-line customers.
Diego (Support): Draft (for high-touch):
```
Hi <Name>,
TL;DR: We experienced an authentication error affecting embedding requests between 11:55–12:14 UTC today which may have caused failed API calls. We've rolled back the change and are monitoring. No customer data was exposed.
What we did: rollback and increased token validation checks.
Mitigation: if you see 401s, please retry after 5 minutes; we will follow up with a detailed RCA and any credits if applicable.
Best,
Redwood Customer Success
```
Maya (CS Ops): We'll need localized versions. I'll coordinate translations with vendor and prepare the FR/DE/JP localized snippets by EOD.
Sam (PM): For renewal-risk list — can CS export the contracts with renewal windows and estimated ARR? I want to pre-authorize credit amounts for affected customers.
Ava (CS): On it. Diego/Maya — please prioritize the 7 high-touch accounts and prepare phone scripts.
IncidentBot: Incident 2026-03-20T11:55-12:14 UTC created: AUTH-EMBED-042. Status: recovering. Link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-AUTH-EMBED-042
Riley (Eng): Posting timeline and logs in the incident doc now. Will add the exact commit and rollback diff for the RCA.
Diego (Support): Who owns sending the first customer email? I can send to mid/bulk once templates approved. Ava to send to high-touch?
Ava (CS): I'll call the top 3 contracts now, then send the tailored emails. Diego — prep the bulk send for 13:30 UTC once I sign off.
Maya (CS Ops): Office hours: 14:00 UTC for any customers who want live troubleshooting. Add to the in-app banner and calendar invite.
Sam (PM): Good. Also capture any customer feedback in the post-incident survey — Maya can you own the feedback capture and tagging for renewal-risk signals?
Maya (CS Ops): Yep — I'll attach tags: "impact=auth-embed", "renewal-risk=triage" and forward responses to the GTM dashboard.
Ava (CS): Thanks team. Riley pls confirm the verification complete timestamp so we can publish the RCA.
Riley (Eng): Will confirm in 30m and post final RCA link.
Ava (CS): Closing loop — after RCA we provide credits per pre-authorized tiers and follow-up 1:1 for high-touch customers.
Diego (Support): Sending draft to @Ava and @Sam for sign-off now.
Ava (CS): Received. Posting the phone call notes after each outreach.
Maya (CS Ops): Translation vendor ETA confirmed: FR/DE 3h, JP 6h. Prioritizing high-touch FR/DE first.
IncidentBot: Update: Incident status changed to "monitored" at 12:40 UTC.
Ava (CS): Great — will update customers at 13:00 UTC with interim note and schedule the detailed RCA for 17:00 UTC.
Sam (PM): Thanks everyone. Keep tagging messages with the incident link.
